hazards.control: Instrument power isolated before sensor changes; cables routed off the ground.

tabs.overview: Clean rate minus slurry rate gives the sand volume; the pump stroke counters give a cross-check.
tabs.engineering: Calibrated with the fluid; turbine meters foul with sand, magnetic meters do not.
tabs.evidence: Field practice at the frac van and wellsite instrumentation (S9); pressure transducer practice (S31 missile patent for header instruments); no vendor data.

name: Flowmeters (clean rate, slurry rate)
function: The turbine or magnetic meters on the blender suction (clean rate) and discharge (slurry rate) that give the treating rate.
